key.name: position
key.summary: Where the island sits: below the top bar, next to the date and time, or in place of the clock

key.name: clock-side
key.summary: Which side of the date and time the island sits on (beside-clock position)

key.name: beside-gap
key.summary: Space between the date and time and the island, in pixels (beside-clock position)

key.name: below-panel
key.summary: Deprecated: use position

key.name: hide-when-idle
key.summary: Hide the island when there is nothing to show (below / beside-clock positions)

key.name: top-gap
key.summary: Gap above the island, in pixels

key.name: pill-height
key.summary: Island height in pixels (edit the size of the island)

key.name: idle-width
key.summary: Width of the empty/idle island in pixels (0 is a round dot)

key.name: expanded-width
key.summary: Width of the expanded media player in pixels

key.name: notif-width
key.summary: Width of a notification in pixels

key.name: notif-gap
key.summary: Extra padding inside notifications, in pixels

key.name: status-width
key.summary: Width of status pills (privacy, hotspot and charging) in pixels

key.name: max-radius
key.summary: Corner roundness

key.name: spring-ms
key.summary: Animation length, in milliseconds

key.name: hover-expand-ms
key.summary: Hover time before the player expands

key.name: hover-collapse-ms
key.summary: Time before the player collapses after the pointer leaves

key.name: media-players
key.summary: Apps whose music shows in the island, comma separated (e.g. "spotify, rhythmbox"). Empty shows every player, including browser videos

key.name: hide-browser-media
key.summary: Don't show videos and sound playing in web browsers (YouTube etc.), only music apps

key.name: suppress-gnome-banners
key.summary: Stop GNOME notification banners and show them in Custom Island instead

key.name: notif-ms
key.summary: How long each notification stays, in milliseconds

key.name: notif-queue-max
key.summary: Notifications held back while a fullscreen app is in front (the newest is shown afterwards)

key.name: notif-show-low-urgency
key.summary: Also show low-priority notifications

key.name: notif-respect-dnd
key.summary: Hide notifications while Do Not Disturb is on

key.name: notif-respect-app-settings
key.summary: Hide notifications from apps whose pop-ups are turned off in Settings

key.name: suppress-gnome-osd
key.summary: Show volume and brightness in the island (hide GNOME's pop-up)

key.name: osd-ms
key.summary: How long volume/brightness stays, in milliseconds

key.name: show-charging
key.summary: Show when the charger is plugged in

key.name: privacy-indicators
key.summary: Show when an app is using the microphone or camera

key.name: hotspot-devices
key.summary: Show personal hotspot on and how many devices are connected

key.name: copied-links
key.summary: Copy & Go: recognise copied links, emails and phone numbers and suggest actions

key.name: link-ms
key.summary: How long the copy suggestions stay, in milliseconds

key.name: charge-ms
key.summary: How long the charging message stays, in milliseconds
